name: Runemaster Primordial Strength converts attack power and Agility into spell damage and hit (#1796)
contract: Primordial Strength 301149 (automatic level 20 Runic entry, CharacterAdvancement 4201): 'Increases your
spell damage by $s1% of your attack power, your hit rating by $s2% of your Agility and your spell hit rating
by an additional $s3% of your Agility.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_ATTACK_POWER 30 on the magic
schools (MiscValue 126); effects 1 and 2 are SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT 3 of Agility (MiscValueB 1) on
melee, ranged and spell hit (MiscValue 224) and on spell hit alone (MiscValue 128). All three are native auras:
SpellBaseDamageBonusDone adds int(AP x 30%) and Player::UpdateRating adds int(Agility x 3%) per effect.
Expected (QA Test +1000 Agility 984582 and +1000 Melee and Ranged AP 10031 make the truncation negligible):
melee and ranged hit rating rise by 3% of Agility, spell hit rating by 6%, and Fire and Arcane spell power
by 30% of attack power; unlearning the passive removes all of it.

steps.label: QA Test +1000 Melee and Ranged AP
CONTRACT: melee hit rating rises by 3% of Agility
CONTRACT: ranged hit rating rises by 3% of Agility
CONTRACT: spell hit rating rises by 3% plus an additional 3% of Agility
CONTRACT: Fire spell power rises by 30% of attack power
CONTRACT: Arcane spell power rises by 30% of attack power
CONTRACT: the hit rating leaves with the passive
